title: Assessing pseudobulk DE adequacy with seny
text: assessAll() chains layers — pseudobulk setup, design/confounding (layer 1), pseudobulk quality (layer 2), variance structure sensitivity (layer 4) — returns one row per comparison. comparison table carries layer-2 cell-quality metrics alongside call. cells_cond_cor correlation log cells-per-sample condition; cells_ratio smaller group median larger; sensitivity_fraction share testable genes detectable target effect. non-adequate call explains : CD4 T clean (Adequate); CD8 T far fewer cells condition B, cell-count imbalance tracks condition breaks equal-variance assumption (Caution — consider voom sampleWeights dreamlet precision weights); NK high -donor variance modest cell count, genes detectable target effect (Underpowered).
code: res <- assessAll(sce, sample = "donor", group = "condition",                  annotations = "cell_type", targetLFC = 1) #> calcNormFactors has been renamed to normLibSizes #> calcNormFactors has been renamed to normLibSizes #> calcNormFactors has been renamed to normLibSizes cols <- c("cluster", "nA", "nB", "median_cells", "gini_cells", "cells_ratio",           "cells_cond_cor", "n_testable", "sensitivity_fraction", "call") knitr::kable(as.data.frame(res)[, cols], digits = 2, row.names = FALSE) d <- as.data.frame(res) for (i in seq_len(nrow(d))) {     cat(d$cluster[i], "->", as.character(d$call[i]), "::", d$reason[i], "\n") } #> CD4T -> Adequate :: adequate  #> CD8T -> Caution :: cell-count imbalance correlated with condition (r -1.00; consider sample weights)  #> NK -> Underpowered :: underpowered (0% of genes detectable at log2FC 1)

title: Layer 1: design validity and confounding — assessDesign

title: Layer 2: pseudobulk quality — assessPseudobulk
text: every comparison, summarises pseudobulks test run : cells contributed per sample inequality, whether cell counts library sizes track condition (breaks equal-variance assumption), many genes testable. Specifically, per comparison: cells per sample (min_cells, median_cells, gini_cells, frac_below_min, fraction cluster's samples dropped fewer minCells cells); group imbalance (cells_ratio, smaller group median larger, cells_cond_cor, correlation log cells condition); libsize_cond_cor (correlation log library size condition); testable genes (n_testable passing edgeR::filterByExpr comparison's design, frac_testable). testable-gene count denominator sensitivity fraction estimateSensitivity(). Outlier-sample detection part layer 3, .

what: Assemble the comparison table and make the adequacy call — callComparisons
title: Assemble the comparison table and make the adequacy call — callComparisons
text: Merges layer metrics one tidy table, one row per comparison, assigns comparison call: Invalid (contrast estimable, samples per group), Caution (estimable condition confounded covariate, cell-count imbalance tracks condition), Underpowered (valid sensitivity fraction target, testable genes), Adequate. Severity order Invalid > Caution > Underpowered > Adequate; reason column lists every flag single call never hides second problem.

what: Layer 4 (sensitivity): minimum detectable effect and power — estimateSensitivity
title: Layer 4 (sensitivity): minimum detectable effect and power — estimateSensitivity
text: null-model variance fits (estimateVariance()), computes analytic standard error two-group log2 fold-change contrast per gene (SE^2 = 1/sum_A w + 1/sum_B w, w = 1/(1/mu + phi_total)), minimum detectable effect target power FDR, power primary target effect. Summarises sensitivity fraction: share testable genes detectable targetLFC. Uncalibrated MVP (calibrate = FALSE); empirical calibration E2/E7 applied later phase.

title: Layer 4 (sensitivity): minimum detectable effect and power — estimateSensitivity
code: estimateSensitivity(   variance,   targetLFC = 1,   power = 0.8,   fdr = 0.05,   pi1 = 0.05,   calibrate = FALSE )

title: Layer 4 (sensitivity): minimum detectable effect and power — estimateSensitivity
text: variance list returned estimateVariance(). targetLFC Primary target absolute log2 fold-change call. Default 1. power Target power. Default 0.8. fdr Target FDR. Default 0.05. pi1 Assumed fraction true positives (maps FDR per-gene threshold, Jung 2005). Default 0.05. calibrate Reserved; must FALSE MVP.

title: Layer 4 (sensitivity): minimum detectable effect and power — estimateSensitivity
text: data.frame, one row per comparison, target_lfc, sensitivity_fraction, median_mde median_power.
